traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Degeneriaceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; margins entire; veins pinnate; stipules absent; plants hermaphrodite; ovary superior; floral cup absent; stems woody; flowers solitary; flowers actinomorphic; perianth sepals and petals; stamens 20 to 30; carpels 1. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
